name: color-contrast
title: color-contrast
description: Measures color contrast with WCAG 2.x ratios and APCA, audits a codebase or stylesheet for failing pairs (including dark mode), and repairs failures with the smallest possible color change.
why: The executable half of color accessibility: it audits real stylesheets, computes real ratios, and fixes failures — measurement work no resident skill does.
adaptations: Root skill only: vendored SKILL.md, scripts/, references/ and LICENSE; the repo README is project documentation, not part of the skill. License recorded as MIT from the vendored LICENSE file (verbatim MIT text; the GitHub API reports NOASSERTION for this repo).
